about.title: About — acikeczanevarmi.com
about.description: What acikeczanevarmi.com is, where the data comes from and how often it is updated.
about.p1: acikeczanevarmi.com is a free site for finding the pharmacies on duty in Northern Cyprus today. The aim is simple: someone who needs medicine at midnight should see the nearest open pharmacy and its phone number in a few seconds, without adverts or extra clicks.
about.sourceP: The duty rosters are taken automatically from the official schedule published by the Cyprus Turkish Pharmacists Association (KTEB). Pharmacy names, addresses, phone numbers and duty hours are passed on as published at the source; this site does not produce the data itself.
about.freshP: The roster is re-fetched automatically several times a day. If the last successful update is older than expected, a warning is shown on the page, so you are never left guessing how fresh what you are reading is.
about.limitsP: This site is not an official body and has no affiliation with KTEB. A correction made at the source may reach this site with a delay. In an emergency, and before setting off, please phone the pharmacy.
about.openTitle: What you will not find here
about.openP: The site shows duty dates, not the pharmacies’ ordinary opening hours — that information is not published at the source.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy — acikeczanevarmi.com
privacy.description: What this site does about location data, cookies and analytics.
privacy.p1: This site has no user accounts, asks for no registration, and was not built to collect personal data. What is processed, and where, is set out below.
privacy.locP: When you use the location feature, your browser asks for your permission. The coordinates you give are sent to the server for that request only, and are used to sort the pharmacies by how near they are to you. They are not written to the database, not tied to any profile, and not passed to third parties. If you decline, the site works exactly as before — the region filter reaches the whole list.
privacy.cookieP: The site sets one cookie, to remember your language. There are no advertising or tracking cookies.
privacy.analyticsP: Vercel Analytics is used to count page views. It does not identify visitors individually and sets no tracking cookie.
privacy.offlineP: The last roster you viewed is kept in your browser’s own cache so it still opens if your connection drops. That data never leaves your device; clearing your browser data removes it.
privacy.thirdP: Directions and map links go to Google Maps, and the data-source link goes to KTEB’s site. Once you follow them, that site’s own privacy policy applies.

contact.title: Contact — acikeczanevarmi.com
contact.description: Report a problem with the site, suggest something, or get in touch.
contact.p1: This site is run by one person. Write to the address below; replies usually take a few days.
contact.dutyTitle: Something wrong in the duty roster?
contact.dutyP: This site does not produce the roster; it passes on what the Cyprus Turkish Pharmacists Association publishes. If a pharmacy or an hour looks wrong, the source most likely published it that way, and the correction has to be made there. Write anyway — I will check whether it is our transcription at fault.
contact.pharmacyTitle: If your pharmacy’s details are wrong
contact.pharmacyP: Tell me if the address, phone number or map position is incorrect. That data comes from the source too, but coordinates can be corrected by hand.
contact.bugP: A page that will not open, something that looks wrong, or a suggestion — write in. Mentioning your device and browser makes it much easier to find.
